auditor: AI subagent /root/performance_controls; authored model product was not implemented by this auditor
implementationRoleBoundary: This auditor implemented collapse-continuity document cache changes, not the authoring catalog, draft UI, generation, store or managed-source path under review.
scope: Actual native browser traces and saved-source artifacts for from-zero four-node draft, representative CNN preset drag and Identity add/undo only. No browser operation, product mutation/import, model execution or runtime certification by this auditor.

fourNodeExpected.edges: Exactly Input.output→Linear.input→GELU.input→Output.input with unique node and edge identities; no hidden branch or fabricated runtime tensor.
fourNodeExpected.source: Independent Python AST: two exact nn constructors (Linear16→8,float32,biasTrue; GELUnone), one forward input, straight-line corresponding constructor calls, one return dict key matching Output ID. No model import/execution.

cnnPresetExpected.edges: Exactly seven output→input edges forming one chain in producer order; node/edge cardinality and exact canonical port facts read from actual saved draft and public SVG.
cnnPresetExpected.source: Six exact constructors and one input; corresponding straight-line forward producer chain and Output-ID dict key. Shapes are hand-declared contract expectations, not runtime observations.

publicDraftSvg: Node IDs/kinds/labels/positions, edge IDs and polyline endpoints must agree with actual saved draft and displayed port circles. Orthogonality is observable; publication aesthetics or no crossings need actual image review beyond this file audit.
managedSource: Four-node generated visible source must exactly match actual generated source copy and actual managed model.py/store source bytes when root provides them. Saved imported architecture should contain one container plus four canonical input/operator/output nodes, exact AST parameters/forward producer port/tensor bindings, correct source line expressions/digest and Output slot.
identityUndo: Compare independent raw public SVG nodes/edges before add, after native Identity drag, and after undo; after add contains one unique unconnected Identity without changing prior nodes/edges, undo restores actual prior node/edge subtree geometry. Saving/generating connected models is distinct from an intentionally unconnected Identity add.
inventory: 17 basic module IDs and three starting-graph IDs may be confirmed from actual UI/catalog artifacts. Representative four-node, one CNN preset and one Identity add do not certify every catalog module, every preset, runtime, training, DL-Playground parity or novice/human task success.
provenance: Every input byte hash and copies remain unchanged; preserve Bf/BK build distinction and native CUA action provenance as transcribed logs, not independent OS trace. No generic regenerate command or product oracle used to create expected results.
